name: An Underrated Talent
summary: In Silverpine Forest, Trevan Rol gives Ott a chance to make a blade to your design. Ott’s simple weapons have earned praise from smiths in the Undercity.

sections.title: A Smith's Chance
sections.body: Trevan Rol asks you to carry materials to Ott in Tarren Mill and offer him a commission. Ott sells simple blades to travelers. Trevan bought one and later took it to the Undercity for maintenance. There, local smiths praised its quality and mistook it for the work of a famous master. Now Ott has the chance to forge a blade to your specifications.

sections.title: Ott's Answer
sections.body: Ott says no one has asked him to make a custom weapon before. He usually crafts humble, functional weapons in his own style and seeks no acclaim. Still, he is willing to try. He wonders why you chose him when smiths in the Undercity also take custom work.

faq.answer: Ott is a weaponsmith in Tarren Mill who sells simple blades to travelers.

faq.q: Why does the Undercity smith want me to find Ott?
faq.answer: The smith bought one of Ott’s blades and was surprised when Undercity smiths praised its quality. The smith wants Ott to have a chance to make something special.

faq.q: What am I bringing to Ott?
faq.answer: You are taking materials to Ott in Tarren Mill and offering him a commission to forge your blade.
Ott says no one has asked him to make a custom weapon before, but he is willing to try.

faq.q: Why does Ott ask why I chose him?
faq.answer: Ott says smiths in the Undercity take custom work, and wonders why you sought him instead.

attribution: In-game quest text: An Underrated Talent
